第三十五章 自爆穿越者身份-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

“愣着干什么，动手啊！”

见这些人的视线都被自己给吸引了，爻雪忍不住对这些人大声吼道。

听到爻雪的吼声，这些人终于是回过了神，连忙举起手中的武器对准周围的丛林狼。

之前他们因为体型上的差距一直都处于被动状态，如今有了那看不见的墙壁作为防御，他们终于能够专心致志的战斗了。

没一会儿的功夫，原本围攻他们的丛林狼死的死跑的跑。

等到危险离开之后，爻雪这才走了过去，脸上带着招牌微笑，说道：“亲，需要帮助吗？”

“你是谁？为什么会出现在这里？”其中一个人警惕地问道。

虽然刚刚这人出手帮助了他们，但是这也并不代表面前的这个人就是友军，尤其是那不似常人的手段，更是让他们充满了警惕。

面对对方的质问，爻雪的眼神中闪过一抹淡淡的伤心，当然，是假装的。

“放心，我不是坏人，我是本场游戏的NPC，是专门来……帮助你们的。”

听到爻雪这样说，这些人的警惕放松了一些，其中一个人大着胆子问道：“帮助我们？那你能怎么帮助我们？”

闻言，爻雪的脸上带着淡淡的笑容，随后大手一挥，地上出现了几件商品：那把刚刚得到的异宝唐刀、异能觉醒药剂、能够恢复体力、快速止血及快速恢复伤势的药剂、各种食物和基础治疗药物。

“这个是异宝唐刀，是杀死怪物之后爆出来的，能够对怪物及秘境中的生物造成额外伤害，比你们手中的武器厉害多了，除此之外还有服用之后能够觉醒异能的药剂，当然，并不是百分之百能够觉醒的。

还有，快速恢复体力的药剂，快速止血的药剂，快速恢复伤势的药剂，普通的急救箱，以及各种食物。就看你们想要什么了。”

听完爻雪的介绍，几人很快就将视线停落在了那几瓶蔚蓝色的药剂上。

“你说的都是真的，这些药剂的效果真的有那么神奇？”

"What are you doing standing still? Take action!"

Seeing that these people's eyes were attracted to her, Yaoxue couldn't help shouting at these people.

Hearing Yaoxue's roar, these people finally came to their senses and quickly raised their weapons and pointed them at the surrounding jungle wolves.

Before, they had been in a passive state due to the difference in size. Now with the invisible wall as a defense, they were finally able to concentrate on fighting.

After a while, the jungle wolves that originally besieged them ran away.

After the danger was gone, Yaoxue walked over, with a signature smile on her face, and said, "Dear, do you need help?"

"Who are you? Why are you here?" one of them asked warily.

Although this person had just helped them, it did not mean that the person in front of them was a friendly force. Especially the unusual method made them wary.

Facing the other party's question, Yaoxue's eyes flashed with a touch of sadness, of course, it was fake.

"Don't worry, I'm not a bad person. I'm an NPC in this game. I'm here specifically to... help you."

Hearing what Yaoxue said, these people relaxed their vigilance, and one of them boldly asked: "Help us? Then how can you help us?"

Hearing this, Yaoxue had a faint smile on her face, and then with a wave of her hand, several products appeared on the ground: the exotic treasure Tang Dao she had just obtained, the potion for awakening powers, potions that can restore physical strength, quickly stop bleeding and quickly recover from injuries, various foods and basic treatment drugs.

"This is an exotic treasure Tang Dao. It is exploded after killing monsters. It can cause extra damage to monsters and creatures in the secret realm. It is much more powerful than the weapons in your hands. In addition, there are potions that can awaken supernatural powers after taking them. Of course, it is not 100% able to awaken.

There are also potions for quickly restoring physical strength, potions for quickly stopping bleeding, potions for quickly recovering from injuries, ordinary first aid kits, and various foods.It depends on what you want."

After listening to Yaoxue's introduction, several people quickly focused their attention on the bottles of azure potions.

"Everything you say is true. Are the effects of these potions really that miraculous?"
